verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a device that stores user credentials and secrets, so the axis applies. The evidence documents no data-export capability. It instead says private keys are generated on the hardware 'where it cannot be exported or extracted.' Community reports say leaving requires manually re-enrolling every account. Support for open standards (OpenPGP, PIV, FIDO2) reduces protocol lock-in, but that is an adjacent feature, not export of the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
